# truenas_replication_config (Resource)

Manages the TrueNAS replication configuration (system-wide replication task concurrency). This is a singleton resource — there is exactly one replication configuration per TrueNAS system, so it is never created or deleted on TrueNAS; Terraform create/update calls replication.config.update, and Terraform delete only removes the resource from state (the configuration is left in place).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_replication_config" "config" {
  max_parallel_replication_tasks = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_parallel_replication_tasks` (Number) Maximum number of replication tasks that may run in parallel. A value of 0 clears the limit (unlimited, null on the wire).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton resource: always "replication_config".
